**Discpress 1.7.0 names more of your games right.**

## Get it

- **[⬇ discpress.html](https://github.com/PowerBeef/discpress/releases/download/v1.7.0/discpress.html)** (about 3 MB): the whole app in one file you keep. If you use the downloaded file, download it again for this version.
- **[🌐 powerbeef.github.io/discpress](https://powerbeef.github.io/discpress/)**: nothing to download, and the way to convert big games on iPhone and iPad. It updates itself.

## Better names

- **Sega's own US games are named right.** Dreamcast, Saturn and Sega CD games Sega published in the US (18 Wheeler, Amok, The Adventures of Batman and Robin and many more) got the European release's name, or none on Sega CD.
- **Each disc of a Sega game is named for itself.** Saturn and Dreamcast discs say which disc of the set they are, so Disc 2 is no longer named Disc 1, and the set gets its playlist.
- **A release of your disc's size wins** over another one that shares its serial number, and a release for another region than the disc's no longer names it.
- **Sets lettered Disc A and Disc B** get a playlist too.

## CHDs that load where you play

- **Saturn and Sega CD games no longer keep their cue sheet** in the CHD when Settings asks for it: Kronos, Yabause and jgenesis can't open such a CHD. The card says so.
- **NAOMI GD-ROMs keep their file's name**, which MAME and Flycast look for in the game's romset.
- **Faster to load (Zstd) warns for more consoles**: PlayStation 2 (AetherSX2 and NetherSX2), Dreamcast and NAOMI (Flycast before 2.3), and PC-FX. **The MiSTer preset** now gives the same warnings, since it uses Zstd too, and says when MiSTer has no core for the console.

## Warned in time

- **Discs that convert but won't play right somewhere now say so on their card**: discs with two sessions (MIL-CDs, Enhanced CDs, every Jaguar CD), Dreamcast MODE2/2048 tracks (Flycast refuses them), 2,048-byte PlayStation ISOs (videos and sound may be missing), and cue sheets with PREGAP or POSTGAP lines or track layouts that particular Saturn, Sega CD, PC Engine, PlayStation and Neo Geo CD emulators misread. Each note names the emulator.
- **CD+G (karaoke) cue sheets are refused with the reason**, instead of failing when converting.

Valid discs give the same CHDs as before, byte for byte the same as chdman 0.289's with the default settings.
